Subject: Stage-gate MAP & Close Roadmap: GPU pool handoff, lead times & acceptance SLAs

Hi Ben / Aurelia team —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our call, I put together an initial stage-gate mutual action plan (MAP) that aligns the evaluation milestones to a staged reservation and handoff for a Dedicated GPU pool (private VPC option). Key goals here are: lock-in target tranche and key lead-time constraints so your infra team can schedule acceptance windows.

High-level summary (attached: Aurelia_MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Stage 0 (Eval): 2-week performance/latency baseline with us on a shared host; key metric: 99th pct latency under 220ms for 4k-token prompts.
- Stage 1 (Pilot reserve): Reserve 2x A100-equivalent units for a 4-week pilot (lead time 6 weeks).
- Stage 2 (Production tranche 1): Expand to 8x units, acceptance window + load test; target delivery 10–12 weeks after signed reservation.
- Acceptance SLA: defined acceptance criteria attached (acceptance_criteria.md).

Open asks from Aurelia to close timeline:
1) Confirm target start date for Stage 1 pilot (we proposed Sep 27).
2) Any constraints on on-prem rack scheduling or key management (KMS/HSM) that affect lead time.
3) Signoff on the acceptance criteria and the DocuSign envelope we’ll send once dates are fixed.

If you’re aligned, I’ll route an updated MAP to you and loop Legal for the reservation agreement. I shaded the calendar with buffer weeks in the attached.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Thanks Monica — this is very helpful. A few clarifications from our side after triaging with infra: 
- We can target Stage 1 pilot start of Sep 29 (not Sep 27) due to maintenance windows.
- KMS: we must use our HSM provider for keys; that adds a 3-week pre-provisioning step for Private deployment.
- Acceptance windows: can you confirm a 72-hour rollback window if the acceptance tests fail? Ops will need that in writing.

We reviewed the spreadsheet quickly — we’ll give a formal signoff early next week after Ops completes a short internal runbook. Can you include the HSM pre-provision step explicitly in Stage 0 -> 1 transition?

Folks —

I reviewed Ben’s asks. Quick notes to include in the revised MAP:
- Add a HSM/KMS pre-provision step with 3-week lead time between Stage 0 signoff and Stage 1 provisioning; owner: Aurelia (ops) + Redwood SecOps for key exchange.
- Update pilot sizing: start with 2x A100-equivalent, but include a burst policy to 4x for short load tests (keeps costs down while validating autoscaling).
- Acceptance SLA: we can commit to a 72-hour rollback/designated rollback window if acceptance load test fails; need mutual ops runbook and a list of test vectors (put into acceptance_criteria.md).
- Logistics: procurement/legal will need a reservation addendum that lists delivery windows in weeks from signed agreement (we’ll capture 6w pilot lead time / 10-12w production tranche).

I’ll draft the edited MAP and drop in the shared HubSpot deal. Karthik — can you draft the reservation addendum language?

-Neha

- Pilot starts Sep 29, lead times reflected as weeks-from-signature.
- Pilot sizing: 2x baseline with 4x burst for load tests; billing note included for burst usage.
- Acceptance SLA: 72-hour rollback clause and required ops runbook + test vectors (see acceptance_criteria.md).

Next steps:
1) Aurelia confirms Sep 29 pilot start and HSM ownership for pre-provisioning.
2) Ben confirms acceptance runbook owner and target signoff date (we recommended Sep 24 for internal signoff).
3) Once confirmed, I’ll route the DocuSign reservation addendum and loop Legal.
